title: Pipelines and Generation
summary: This module provides high-level, task-specific pipelines for common NLP and multimodal applications, alongside the core logic and decoding strategies for efficient text generation, including continuous batching.

nodes.label: Core Generation Logic
nodes.title: Core Text Generation Logic
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental algorithms and control flow for auto-regressive text generation, including various decoding strategies like greedy, sampling, beam search, and continuous batching.

nodes.label: Task-Specific Pipelines
nodes.title: Task-Specific Pipelines
nodes.description: Offers high-level, ready-to-use pipelines for common NLP and multimodal tasks such as automatic speech recognition, document question answering, and image-to-text generation, abstracting model complexities.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures
nodes.description: Represents the collection of pre-trained model architectures (e.g., LLMs, vision models) that are used by the generation and pipeline components for inference.

nodes.label: Data Processing Modules
nodes.title: Data Processing Modules
nodes.description: Handles the preprocessing of raw input data (text, audio, images) into a format suitable for model consumption, including tokenization and feature extraction.

nodes.label: Serving & Integrations
nodes.title: Serving & Optimization Integrations
nodes.description: Encompasses tools and integrations for optimizing model serving, such as quantization techniques and CLI tools for deploying models with continuous batching.

groups.label: Core Functionality
groups.title: Core Generation & Pipelines
groups.description: The primary components within this module, responsible for orchestrating text generation and providing high-level task interfaces.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: Dependent Modules
groups.description: Other modules within the Transformers library that provide essential models, data preprocessing, and serving optimizations for generation and pipelines.
